---
title: "Colon recurrence report"
format: html
execute: 
  echo: false
  warning: false
  error: false
---

```{r}
library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(gtsummary)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
colonr <- 
  colon |> 
  filter(etype == 1) |> 
  mutate(
    years = time / 365.25,
    sex = case_match(
      sex,
      0 ~ "Female",
      1 ~ "Male"
    )
  ) |> 
  labelled::set_variable_labels(
    rx = "Treatment", 
    sex = "Sex"
  )
```

In a clinical trial, patients were randomized to receive adjuvant chemotherapy with either levamisole, levamisole + 5-FU, or placebo. Interest was in whether treatment group was associated with time to recurrence.

Time to recurrence was measured from the date of treatment start to the date of recurrence or last known date the patient was recurrence-free. The Kaplan-Meier method was used to estimate recurrence-free probabilities. Multivariable Cox regression adjusted for age and sex. 

```{r fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4.5}
survfit2(Surv(years, status) ~ rx, data = colonr) |>
  ggsurvfit() + 
  add_risktable(risktable_stats = "n.risk") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = seq(0, 8, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ezfun::ccf_palette("contrast")) +
  labs(
    x = "Years from treatment start",
    y = "Recurrence-free probability"
  ) + 
  add_pvalue()
```

```{r}
tab1 <-
  colonr |> 
  tbl_survfit(
    y = Surv(years, status),
    include = rx,
    times = 5,
    label_header = "{time}-year RFS (95% CI)"
    )

tab1
```

The 5-year (95% CI) recurrence-free probability is `r inline_text(tab1, variable = rx, level = 'Obs', time = 5)`, `r inline_text(tab1, variable = rx, level = 'Lev', time = 5)`, and `r inline_text(tab1, variable = rx, level = 'Lev+5FU', time = 5)` for the placebo, levamisole, and levamisole + 5-FU groups, respectively.

```{r}
tab2 <-
  coxph(Surv(years, status) ~ rx + sex + age, data = colonr) |> 
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = T) |> 
  add_global_p()

tab2
```

Levamisole + 5-FU was associated with a hazard ratio of `r inline_text(tab2, variable = rx, level = 'Lev+5FU', pattern = "{estimate} (95% CI {conf.low}, {conf.high})")` for recurrence as compared to placebo.
